sections.title: The roster table
sections.intro: A global in init.lua and its modules, and also require("roster"). A Plugin gets a bigger one: the Plugin API.

entries.heading: roster.os
entries.about: The OS the app runs on.

entries.heading: roster.api_version
entries.about: The version of this table, raised when it changes.

entries.heading: roster.set(name, value)
entries.about: Sets any option by its dotted name. The name and the value are checked like the returned table's; an error points at the call's line. The returned table wins over a call that sets the same option.

rows.name: name
rows.about: An option's dotted name: "terminal.size".

rows.name: value
rows.about: Its value, as the option takes it.

entries.heading: roster.keymap.set(context, keys, action)
entries.about: Binds a key, as `keys.<context>` does.

rows.name: context
rows.about: The keymap's context.

rows.name: keys
rows.about: A chord or a sequence of chords separated by spaces: "Ctrl+n", "d d".

rows.name: action
rows.about: A command line, or false to unbind a default.

entries.heading: roster.themes.define(id, theme)
entries.about: Defines a Theme, as `themes.<id>` does.

rows.name: id
rows.about: The Theme's id (not "auto").

rows.name: theme
rows.about: A Theme spec.

entries.heading: theme
entries.about: The Theme to use, or "auto" to follow the OS's light or dark setting with dark_theme and light_theme.
entries.takes: a Theme's id, or "auto"

entries.heading: dark_theme
entries.about: The Theme "auto" picks while the OS is dark.
entries.takes: a Theme's id

entries.heading: light_theme
entries.about: The Theme "auto" picks while the OS is light.
entries.takes: a Theme's id

entries.heading: themes
entries.about: New Themes, or changed copies of bundled ones, by id: each a Theme spec.

entries.heading: colors
entries.about: UI colour tokens set over whichever Theme is in use.

entries.heading: fonts
entries.about: The UI's fonts.

entries.heading: fonts.ui
entries.about: The UI's font.
entries.takes: a family name, or a CSS font stack (anything with a comma)

entries.heading: fonts.mono
entries.about: The wordmark's and code-like UI text's font.
entries.takes: a family name, or a CSS font stack

entries.heading: fonts.ui_size
entries.about: The UI's text size; the smaller steps, the row height and the Sidebar's width follow it.
entries.takes: 11 to 20 px

entries.heading: ui
entries.about: The rest of the UI's look.

entries.heading: ui.hints
entries.about: false hides every keycap hint. Unset, :hints decides and the State keeps its choice; set, it wins.

entries.heading: ui.messages
entries.about: What the message line shows: errors, warnings and answers only ("quiet"), or routine confirmations too ("all"). Unset, :messages decides.

entries.heading: terminal
entries.about: The terminal's font, look and behaviour.

entries.heading: terminal.font
entries.about: Font families, most wanted first: the first one installed is used.
entries.takes: a font name, a CSS font stack, or a list of names

entries.heading: terminal.size
entries.about: The font size: a number is px, "16pt" is points (as Windows Terminal converts them), "21px" works too.
entries.takes: 6 to 72 px (4.5 to 54 pt)

entries.heading: terminal.weight
entries.about: The font weight; the bundled Iosevka has 400, 500 and 700.

entries.heading: terminal.bold_weight
entries.about: The weight of bold (SGR 1) text.

entries.heading: terminal.bold_is_bright
entries.about: Bold text in the bright ANSI colours too.

entries.heading: terminal.line_height
entries.about: A multiple of the font's own line height.

entries.heading: terminal.cell_height
entries.about: A multiple of the font size, as Windows Terminal's cellHeight; wins over line_height.

entries.heading: terminal.renderer
entries.about: WebGL (fast) or the DOM (the browser's own text rendering).

entries.heading: terminal.cursor_style
entries.about: The cursor's shape.

entries.heading: terminal.scrollback
entries.about: How many lines the terminal keeps above the screen.
entries.takes: 0 to 1000000 lines

entries.heading: terminal.copy_on_select
entries.about: Selecting text copies it.

entries.heading: terminal.right_click_paste
entries.about: Right-click copies the selection, or pastes when there's none.

entries.heading: terminal.colors
entries.about: Any terminal or ANSI colour, set over the Theme's.

entries.heading: terminal.shell_hooks
entries.about: Send each Session's shell the line that turns on prompt marks (OSC 133) and its folder (OSC 7). Unset, a Host's shell_hooks in roster.yml decides.

entries.heading: leader
entries.about: The chord that takes the keyboard back from a terminal.
entries.takes: a chord: "Ctrl+Space", "ctrl+b", "C-b" or "<C-b>", with Ctrl, Alt or Meta

entries.heading: vim
entries.about: j/k/h/l/gg/G in lists and the Picker.

entries.heading: keys
entries.about: Key bindings, per context: key or sequence → action.

entries.heading: keys.leader
entries.about: After the Leader: key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.list
entries.about: In a list (the Sidebar): key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.list_vim
entries.about: In a list while vim keys are on: key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.picker
entries.about: In the Picker and every finder: key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.picker_vim
entries.about: In the Picker's list while vim keys are on: key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.cmdline
entries.about: In the : command line: key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.terminal
entries.about: In a terminal, before the shell sees the key: key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: keys.global
entries.about: Everywhere, with no Leader (keep it to keys a shell doesn't use): key or sequence (chords separated by spaces: "d d") → key action.

entries.heading: default_mode
entries.about: The view mode at start (read at start only).

entries.heading: sessions
entries.about: Open Sessions in the Sidebar, or in a tab strip.

entries.heading: modes
entries.about: Each view mode's layout.

entries.heading: modes.standard
entries.about: The Standard mode's pieces; a piece left out keeps this mode's default.

entries.heading: modes.standard.titlebar
entries.about: The title bar.

entries.heading: modes.standard.sidebar
entries.about: The Sidebar: shown or hidden, the side it's on, and its sections.
entries.takes: true, false, or a table of the options below (which shows it)

entries.heading: modes.standard.sidebar.side
entries.about: The side of the window it's on.

entries.heading: modes.standard.sidebar.sections
entries.about: Its sections, in order; all of them when left out.
entries.takes: section ids in order: "sessions", "folders", "inventory", or a Plugin section's id

entries.heading: modes.standard.sessionbar
entries.about: The thin tmux-style bar of open Sessions, and its edge.

entries.heading: modes.standard.statusbar
entries.about: The status bar, and its segments.
entries.takes: true, false, or segments in order: "backend", "box", "hosts", "path", "changes", "hints", "mode"

entries.heading: modes.standard.fullscreen
entries.about: OS fullscreen.

entries.heading: modes.standard.toolbar
entries.about: The controls for common commands, in the title bar (or a bar of their own without one).
entries.takes: true, false, or controls in order: "sidebar", "find", "quick", "add", "changes", "publish", "details", "cmdline", "keys", "help", "lock", "mode", or a Plugin control's id

entries.heading: modes.focus
entries.about: The Focus mode's pieces; a piece left out keeps this mode's default.

entries.heading: modes.focus.titlebar
entries.about: The title bar.

entries.heading: modes.focus.sidebar
entries.about: The Sidebar: shown or hidden, the side it's on, and its sections.
entries.takes: true, false, or a table of the options below (which shows it)

entries.heading: modes.focus.sidebar.side
entries.about: The side of the window it's on.

entries.heading: modes.focus.sidebar.sections
entries.about: Its sections, in order; all of them when left out.
entries.takes: section ids in order: "sessions", "folders", "inventory", or a Plugin section's id

entries.heading: modes.focus.sessionbar
entries.about: The thin tmux-style bar of open Sessions, and its edge.

entries.heading: modes.focus.statusbar
entries.about: The status bar, and its segments.
entries.takes: true, false, or segments in order: "backend", "box", "hosts", "path", "changes", "hints", "mode"

entries.heading: modes.focus.fullscreen
entries.about: OS fullscreen.

entries.heading: modes.focus.toolbar
entries.about: The controls for common commands, in the title bar (or a bar of their own without one).
entries.takes: true, false, or controls in order: "sidebar", "find", "quick", "add", "changes", "publish", "details", "cmdline", "keys", "help", "lock", "mode", or a Plugin control's id

entries.heading: panel
entries.about: What every panel and view starts with.

entries.heading: panel.width
entries.about: A docked panel's width, for every panel and view views doesn't give one. Unset, each keeps its own.
entries.takes: 10 to 95 percent of the window

entries.heading: views
entries.about: Per panel or view id (help, details, a Plugin view's id): where it opens first, and its width.

entries.heading: folders
entries.about: Folders kept in the Config, read-only in the app: each a Folder spec.

entries.heading: vault
entries.about: This Box's own vault settings, over roster.yml's providers. Paths and choices, never a secret.
entries.example: roster.set("vault", { save_to = { organization = "My Team", collection = "Infra logins" } })

entries.heading: vault.save_to
entries.ty: "personal"|{ organization: string, collection: string }|{ group: string }
entries.about: Where Save to vault puts a new password by default.
entries.takes: "personal", { organization = …, collection = … } (Bitwarden) or { group = … } (KeePassXC)

entries.heading: vault.kp
entries.about: KeePassXC's files, on the Box roster runs on.

entries.heading: vault.kp.database
entries.about: KeePassXC's .kdbx.
entries.takes: an absolute path, or one starting with ~

entries.heading: vault.kp.key_file
entries.about: A key file used with the database's master password.
entries.takes: an absolute path, or one starting with ~

entries.heading: packages
entries.about: Plugins fetched from git repos and pinned in roster.lock: each a Package spec, or just its source.

entries.heading: plugin_proxy
entries.about: The proxy Plugins' requests to public names go through. Unset, they go direct.
entries.takes: http://HOST:PORT, the port written out, with no user or password

entries.heading: idle_lock_minutes
entries.about: Lock after this many minutes without input.
entries.takes: 1 to 1440 minutes

entries.heading: pull_fresh_minutes
entries.about: How old the last pull of the infra repo may be before a form pulls again; 0 pulls every time.
entries.takes: 0 to 1440 minutes

entries.heading: auto_reload
entries.about: Reload on every save of a .lua file of the Config, and of roster.yml. Off, :source reloads.

entries.heading: editor
entries.about: What :config opens init.lua with: the desktop's app for .lua files, or $EDITOR inside WSL.

entries.heading: backend
entries.about: Which roster the app runs: detected, this machine's, or WSL's.
entries.takes: "auto", "local", "wsl" or "wsl:<distro>"

entries.heading: roster_command
entries.about: The command that runs roster, for development: a command line (split on spaces) or a list of words. Unset, roster.
entries.takes: roster itself: "roster", a path ending in /roster, or "uv run --project <dir> roster"

sections.title: Types
sections.intro: The tables some options hold, by the names :config types gives them.

entries.heading: roster.config.Theme
entries.about: A Theme spec: a bundled Theme (base) with tokens changed, or a new one.

rows.name: label
rows.about: Its name in the app; the id when left out.

rows.name: appearance
rows.about: Which OS appearance it suits; the base's when left out.

rows.name: base
rows.about: The Theme it starts from: every token it doesn't set comes from there (Roster dark, or Roster light for appearance = "light", when left out). Takes a Theme's id.

rows.name: colors
rows.about: UI colour tokens over the base's.

rows.name: terminal
rows.about: The terminal's colours, apart from the 16 ANSI ones, over the base's.

rows.name: ansi
rows.about: The 16 ANSI colours; false keeps the standard palette even when the base has its own; the base's when left out.

entries.heading: roster.config.KeyAction
entries.about: A key action: the command line a key runs, or false to unbind a default.
entries.takes: a command line, exactly what you'd type after : ("close", "session 1"), or false

entries.heading: roster.config.View
entries.about: A view spec: one panel's or view's default place and width.

rows.name: place
rows.about: Docked beside the terminal, or over the whole window.

rows.name: width
rows.about: Its docked width. Takes 10 to 95 percent of the window.

entries.heading: roster.config.Folder
entries.about: A Folder spec: a name and the Hosts in it.

rows.name: name
rows.about: The Folder's name. Takes unique, ignoring case, with no double quote.

rows.name: hosts
rows.about: The Hosts in it, in order. Takes Host names.

entries.heading: roster.config.Package
entries.about: A Package spec: { SOURCE, tag = …, config = { … } }, or just SOURCE.

rows.name: source
rows.about: Where the repo is: the spec's first item, or source = …. Takes "owner/repo" (GitHub), or a git URL: https://…, ssh://…, git@host:path, file://… or a full path.

rows.name: name
rows.about: Its name (its folder and its line in roster.lock); the repo's (or dir's) name when left out.

rows.name: tag
rows.about: The tag to pin. At most one of tag, branch and commit; none means the default branch.

rows.name: branch
rows.about: The branch to follow.

rows.name: commit
rows.about: The commit to pin. Takes 4 to 40 hex digits.

rows.name: dir
rows.about: The repo's folder that holds the Plugin, when it isn't the top. Takes a folder inside the repo, relative, / between folders, no ...

rows.name: config
rows.about: Settings the Package reads as roster.plugin.config. Takes a table (never a function).
